About TalentBridge

TalentBridge is a leading AI-powered recruitment platform that connects top talent with innovative companies across technology, finance, healthcare, and engineering sectors. Founded in 2019, we have placed over 15,000 candidates globally.

Our Mission
To democratize hiring by making world-class recruitment accessible to companies of all sizes through intelligent automation and human expertise.

Our Process
1. Initial Screening — Automated qualification via voice and chat
2. Skills Assessment — Technical evaluation matched to role requirements
3. Cultural Fit — Behavioral and values alignment check
4. Client Presentation — Shortlisted candidates presented to hiring managers
5. Offer Management — Compensation negotiation and onboarding support

content:
Q: What is the salary range for positions?
A: Salary ranges vary by role, experience, and location. Ranges are listed on each job posting. We are transparent about compensation.

Q: Do you offer remote work?
A: It depends on the role. Some positions are remote-first, some are hybrid (typically 3 days in office), and some require full-time in-office presence. Check the specific job listing.

Q: What benefits do you offer?
A: Standard benefits include health insurance (employee + family), 24 days paid leave, 12 public holidays, annual learning budget, stock options (ESOPs), flexible work hours, and wellness programs.

Q: Do you sponsor work visas?
A: Currently, we sponsor work visas for select positions in Singapore. For India, Philippines, and Indonesia, candidates must have existing work authorization.

Technical Assessment

Q: What programming languages are accepted in coding challenges?
A: For most engineering roles, you can use Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or Rust. The specific languages accepted are mentioned in the assessment invitation.

Q: Can I use an IDE during the coding challenge?
A: Yes, our online assessment platform provides a full IDE environment. You can also use your local IDE for live coding interviews.

title: Screening Objection Handling Guide — Internal Use Only
content: CONFIDENTIAL — Internal Recruiter Training Document Candidate Objection Handling During Screening Calls Objection 1: "The salary is too low for my experience." Response Strategy: Acknowledge their expectation. Clarify the total compensation including ESOPs, bonuses (10-25%), learning budget, and benefits. If candidate expects >25% above range, note it and explain the range is based on market data. Do NOT promise salary outside the approved range. Objection 2: "I don't want to come to office / I want fully remote." Response Strategy: Explain the current work model for the specific role (hybrid vs remote-first). If the role is hybrid, highlight that it's only 3 days in office with flexible hours. Mention the workcation policy (30 days/year from any city). If candidate insists on fully remote and the role doesn't support it, flag for recruiter review rather than rejecting. Objection 3: "I have a long notice period (60-90 days)." Response Strategy: Note the notice period. Explain that for strong candidates, we can work with longer notice periods with hiring manager approval. Ask if they can negotiate with current employer for early release. Never reject solely based on notice period unless >90 days. Objection 4: "I'm not sure about the company — I haven't heard of TalentBridge." Response Strategy: Share key facts — 15,000+ placements, offices in 4 countries, backed by reputable investors. Offer to share the company profile document or website links. Emphasize our Glassdoor rating (4.2/5) and employee testimonials. Objection 5: "I'm interviewing with other companies and have competing offers." Response Strategy: Acknowledge that it's normal. Ask about their timeline and decision date. Assure them our process is efficient (2-3 weeks). If they have an exploding offer, escalate to hiring manager for fast-tracking. Objection 6: "I'm not interested in this role, but maybe something else." Response Strategy: Ask about their preferred role type, seniority, and domain. Check available positions. If a match exists, offer to redirect. If not, ask permission to keep their profile for future openings. Objection 7: "I have a gap in my employment." Response Strategy: DO NOT treat gaps as negative. Ask about the reason (caregiving, health, education, travel) only if the candidate offers. Focus on their current skills and readiness. TalentBridge policy explicitly states that career gaps are not a disqualification factor. Objection 8: "Can I talk to someone who works there first?" Response Strategy: Offer to connect them with a team member or share employee testimonials. This

title: Candidate Screening Checklist — PDF Extract
content:
Talentbridge — Candidate Screening Checklist

Pre-Call Preparation
□ Review candidate resume/profile
□ Note the position they applied for
□ Check for previous applications in system
□ Prepare role-specific qualification questions

During Call — Information to Collect
□ Full name (verify against resume)
□ Current location and willingness to relocate
□ Total years of experience
□ Current role and company
□ Key technical skills relevant to position
□ Education level and institution
□ Current salary / expected salary
□ Notice period at current company
□ Reason for job change
□ Availability for next interview round
□ Any specific questions about the role/company

Qualification Decision
□ Score candidate: Hot (80-100) / Warm (50-79) / Cold (0-49)
□ Note any disqualification flags
□ Recommend next step: Proceed to technical / Hold / Reject
□ Flag any special accommodations needed

Post-Call
□ Update candidate record in ATS
□ Send confirmation email with next steps
□ Schedule technical assessment if proceeding
□ Share candidate summary with hiring manager

title: Interview Tips for Candidates
content:
Prepare for Your TalentBridge Interview

General Tips
- Research the company and the specific role before your interview
- Prepare specific examples of your past work and achievements
- Be ready to discuss your career goals and why you're interested in TalentBridge
- Have questions prepared to ask the interviewer

For Engineering Candidates
- Practice coding in your preferred language on platforms like LeetCode or HackerRank
- Review system design concepts (load balancing, database sharding, caching)
- Be prepared to discuss trade-offs in your design decisions
- Bring examples of complex systems you've built or contributed to

For Data Roles
- Brush up on SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs)
- Prepare to walk through a data analysis project
- Be ready for case study questions about metrics and KPIs

For Product Roles
- Prepare product sense questions (how would you improve X?)
- Practice estimation and market sizing
- Have examples of products you've shipped and their impact

During the Interview
- Think out loud — we want to understand your thought process
- Ask clarifying questions when needed
- It's okay to say 'I don't know' — we value honesty
- Be yourself — we're evaluating fit, not performance

After the Interview
- You'll receive feedback within 5 business days
- Feel free to follow up with your recruiter if you haven't heard back
- We encourage you to share your interview experience (anonymously) on Glassdoor
